files.search.css: .token-search{max-width:800px;color:#202c3b}.token-search>label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}.search-editor{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid #8996a9;border-radius:8px;padding:8px}.search-editor:focus-within{outline:2px solid #365dc9}.search-editor ol{display:contents;list-style:none}.search-editor li{display:flex;max-width:100%;border:1px solid #abb9d1;border-radius:5px;background:#edf2fd}.search-editor button{font:inherit;padding:6px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:inherit}.search-editor li button:first-child{overflow-wrap:anywhere;min-width:0}.search-editor input{flex:1;min-width:100px;border:0;padding:8px;font:inherit;background:transparent}.token-search :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #365dc9;outline-offset:2px}.token-search [role=listbox]{list-style:none;padding:4px;border:1px solid #aab5c5;border-radius:6px;max-height:240px;overflow:auto}.token-search [role=option]{padding:10px;cursor:pointer}.token-search [aria-selected=true]{background:#e6edff;font-weight:700}.token-search p{font-size:12px}.search-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}
